name: Pearly Everlasting
desc: Common pearlyeverlasting (Anaphalis margaritacea): a plant that turns sunlight into food. Recorded 18 times near the park in GBIF.
about: Anaphalis margaritacea, commonly known as the western pearly everlasting or pearly everlasting, is an Asian and North American species of flowering perennial plant in the family Asteraceae.
